source.publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Office of Foreign Labor Certification

definitions.approval_count: Count of LCA cases whose status begins with Certified, including Certified - Withdrawn.
definitions.approval_rate: approval_count divided by approval_count plus Denied; Withdrawn is excluded from the denominator.
definitions.certified_positions: Sum of TOTAL_WORKER_POSITIONS on approved LCA cases.
definitions.entity_deduplication: Rows are grouped by FEIN when present, otherwise normalized employer name. FEIN values are not exported.
definitions.hq_location: Most frequent employer city/state in the disclosure file; this may be a filing address, not corporate headquarters.
